state_note: These are changes to the executable mechanism in this unit's owned subtree, each caused by a failing observation and each retained only after an independent recurrence test. They are distinct from source claims, from hypotheses and from the unbound strategy proposals.

changes.observation: The first execution of the focused suite failed test_differing_checkout_locations_do_not_create_a_false_positive. Output normalisation used one shared replacement table, so the warm checkout collapsed to <WARM_CHECKOUT> while the clean checkout collapsed to a sandbox path token. A workload that merely printed its working directory therefore diverged, and the runner reported HIDDEN_STATE_DEPENDENCY_UNATTRIBUTED for a workload with no hidden-state dependency.
changes.change: Normalisation became per side: each side's own checkout, HOME, TMPDIR and cache root collapse to the same tokens <CHECKOUT>, <HOME>, <TMPDIR> and <CACHE>, applied longest-needle-first so nested roots do not shadow each other.
changes.recurrence_assertion: Both sides must print exactly 'CWD <CHECKOUT>' and share one outcome digest, and the verdict must be NO_HIDDEN_STATE_DEPENDENCY_DETECTED.
changes.cost: Location-only differences are deliberately invisible, which is recorded as limitation LIM-PO03-WA-008-03 rather than left implicit.

changes.observation: The read-only census of the live controller checkout classified working-tree files by path membership in the commit tree only. A tracked file edited in place is hidden state, yet it was invisible to both the census and the inventory, so an unattributed divergence would have looked unexplained.
changes.change: The runner now records modified tracked content via git diff --name-only <commit> as hidden_state_inventory.out_of_scope_state, includes those paths in the classification digest, and lists MODIFIED_TRACKED_CONTENT, CHECKOUT_REF_STATE and ABSOLUTE_PATH_OR_HOST_DEPENDENCE as out_of_scope_candidates whenever a divergence is unattributed. The scope of attribution is unchanged: the three classes named by the frozen hypothesis remain the only attributable classes.
changes.recurrence_test: test_differential_run.AdversarialBoundTests.test_modified_tracked_content_is_reported_as_out_of_scope plus fixture unattributed-modified-tracked-file in the matrix
changes.recurrence_assertion: A warm checkout whose tracked data.txt was edited must yield HIDDEN_STATE_DEPENDENCY_UNATTRIBUTED, no attributed class, modified_tracked_paths == ['data.txt'] and MODIFIED_TRACKED_CONTENT among the out-of-scope candidates.

changes.observation: The report carried the absolute runtime sandbox path in sandbox_root_actual_excluded_from_digest, so a committed report would have embedded a /tmp location that cannot exist in a clean clone.
changes.change: The field was removed; the report keeps only the <SANDBOX> token. Live-checkout observations, which necessarily name a runtime location, moved out of reproduction-result.json into the separate live-checkout-census.json so the reproduction result stays clean-clone reproducible.
changes.recurrence_assertion: A serialised report must contain no path under the platform temporary directory, and sandbox_root and repo must be the tokens <SANDBOX> and <REPO>.
changes.verified_on_artifacts: grep for the temporary-directory prefix in reproduction-result.json, fixture-matrix-result.json and test-output.txt returns zero matches.

changes.observation: The runner was pointed at a subset of this unit's own committed test suite at commit 891a5e6df0776272c9391bcf48db53fff6993121. Both sides passed with exit code 0 and four tests, yet the verdict was HIDDEN_STATE_DEPENDENCY_ATTRIBUTED to ENVIRONMENT_LEAKAGE. The cause was unittest's own summary line: the warm side printed 'Ran 4 tests in 0.011s' and the clean side '0.010s'. Path normalisation did not touch volatile text, the within-side repetition control happened to see a stable duration on each side, and the environment probe reproduced the warm digest by timing coincidence. This is a false positive that could have been attributed to the wrong cause with high confidence.
changes.change: Normalisation now scrubs a narrow set of volatile patterns after path tokenisation: durations matching a numeric-plus-s token, and ISO-8601 wall-clock timestamps. The pattern list is a constructor argument, is recorded in the report and is part of the classification digest, and the CLI exposes --keep-volatile-output to disable it. Digests, commit ids and other identifiers are deliberately not scrubbed.
changes.implemented_in: differential_run.py DEFAULT_VOLATILE_PATTERNS, normalise_output, execute, run_side, DifferentialRun, classification_digest and build_parser
changes.recurrence_test: test_differential_run.CleanControlTests.test_volatile_output_control_is_clean_only_because_it_is_scrubbed and test_scrubbing_does_not_mask_a_real_content_difference, plus fixture clean-control-volatile-output in the matrix
changes.recurrence_assertion: A workload emitting a fresh duration and timestamp must be CLEAN with scrubbing and must not be CLEAN with volatile_patterns disabled; and with scrubbing enabled a genuine content difference must still diverge.

post_change_self_application.note: ENVIRONMENT_LEAKAGE was still present in the inventory because the CLI inherited the ambient runtime environment; it was correctly not attributed.

changes.cost: A workload whose result is itself a duration or a timestamp is masked; recorded as limitation LIM-PO03-WA-008-16.

rejections.candidate: Attribute a divergence to whichever hidden-state class happens to be present when no probe reproduces the warm outcome.
rejections.reason: Two fixtures show a divergence caused by state outside the declared classes while a decoy untracked file is present; a presence-based heuristic would have produced a confident wrong attribution.
rejections.evidence: unattributed-git-ref-state and unattributed-modified-tracked-file both keep attributed_classes empty.

rejections.candidate: Compare the two sides with a single run each, to halve the runtime.
rejections.reason: Without a within-side repetition control, an intrinsically nondeterministic command diverges across sides and is reported as a hidden-state dependency.
rejections.evidence: test_determinism_control_requires_more_than_one_run_per_side shows the nondeterministic fixture is not classified NONDETERMINISTIC_COMMAND at repeats=1 and is at repeats=2.

rejections.candidate: Record leaked environment values in the report so a reviewer can inspect them.
rejections.reason: An ambient environment can carry credentials; a committed artefact must not become a secret sink. Key names, value digests and value lengths are sufficient for attribution and for reviewer diffing.
rejections.evidence: test_environment_values_are_never_written_to_the_report asserts a credential-shaped value is absent from the serialised report while its SHA-256 is present.
